item.title: Education Daily · November 3, 2026
item.description: Every education story today points the same way: how AI gets into the classroom. The Ministry of Education’s Fujiang programme opened in Guangxi — 14 cities, 20 counties, 60 schools — on the same day it ordered nationwide AI training for teachers; 81% say AI saves them preparation time, while the harder barrier turns out to be confidence, not skill. More than 700 companies brought "AI leads the way" as the theme to the national equipment fair. And 15 listed education companies reported 18.775 billion yuan of nine-month revenue — after two years of AI talk, delivery is starting to appear in the accounts. The threshold was never the hardware. Ministry of Education’s Fujiang programme launches in Guangxi: 14 cities, 20 counties, 60 schools
